text:
jordan: Heads-up — planning a short maintenance window this Saturday 03:00-04:00 UTC to push a runtime hotfix and pin a few model variants. Affects hosted inference only. Will post statuspage and customer email.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: runtime-hotfix-2026-03-21 at 2026-03-21T03:05:00Z. Canary: 50 req/s for 10m. Rollout strategy: linear 10% -> 100% over 20m.

maya: Can we draft the customer-facing blurb now? Want to make sure we don't overpromise on SLAs.

sam: Suggested statuspage update: "We are performing a brief maintenance to deploy a runtime hotfix that improves stability for high-concurrency inference. Some requests may see transient errors or increased latency for up to 5 minutes during the rollout. Impacted: Hosted API. ETA: ~60 minutes for full rollout."

support: Add note to target EU customers with their local times and include link to DNS region list. Also suggest a short actionable line: "No action required — retry will auto-resume."

emma: Dev/ops notes for comms and runbook: pin models that are rolling out to production using our tool, example: ```redwoodctl model pin --model rwd-llama-65B --version 2026-03-15```. If canary shows >1% 5xx or p95 latency >2x baseline for 2 consecutive 5m checks, trigger rollback. Rollback command: ```redwoodctl deploy rollback --service runtime --to v2026-03-14-hotfix```.

jordan: Good. Let's include a short customer email template and the statuspage snippet in the thread so Support can copy.

sam: Email subject: "Planned maintenance: short downtime for runtime stability (Mar 21 UTC)"

sam: Email body snippet: "We're deploying a short runtime update to improve inference stability. Expected window: Mar 21 03:00–04:00 UTC. During the rollout some hosted API requests may return 5xx or see brief latency increases. No action required — requests will automatically retry. If you rely on strict SLA windows, contact support for reserved maintenance scheduling. — Redwood Inference Ops"

maya: Statuspage component update (short): "Ongoing maintenance: deploying runtime hotfix. Some hosted API requests may temporarily fail or be slower. We're monitoring and will post updates here."

support: Suggested customer-facing timing conversion: "Mar 21 03:00–04:00 UTC (Mar 20 20:00–21:00 ET; Mar 21 04:00–05:00 CET)" — I'll attach to the email.

emma: Runbook checklist for on-call during rollout: 1) Monitor canary error rate and p95 (dashboard link). 2) If canary breach, pause rollout and notify releases + oncall. 3) If breach persists after 10m of investigation, run rollback command above. 4) If rollback executed, update statuspage to "Incident: Rollback executed — mitigating user impact."

oncall-bot: Canary hold triggered at 2026-03-21T03:12:00Z: p95 latency x2 baseline. Rollout paused by maya.

maya: Paused rollout, investigating logs. Reproducer shows KV cache miss spike after kernel change. Rolling model pins for affected pool now.

jordan: Support — prep a follow-up short message for customers in case we need to roll back: "Update: We paused the rollout and are rolling back to previous runtime version to restore normal service. Minimal customer impact expected; no action required. We'll post a full postmortem if any customer-visible errors occurred."

support: Copy that. I'll queue the statuspage update and send to the incident channel template.

emma: If rollback completes, add this to the statuspage: "Completed: Rollback to v2026-03-14-hotfix completed at 03:28 UTC — service restored. We're investigating root cause and will follow up."

jordan: Thanks team. After service stable, we'll send a brief post-update email with what changed and pinned versions. Action items: maya — finalize statuspage copy; support — prepare email send list; emma — stickied runbook steps; sam — update release notes with pin details.

maya: On it. I'll drop final copy in #support-drafts in 10m. :thumbsup:

support: I'll hold the scheduled statuspage publish until we confirm rollback result.

deply-bot (typo test): This message intentionally exists to ensure bots are in participants list.

jordan: Ignore stray bot message. Closing thread for now — will reopen if further actions.
